result: Define an API-owned MapControlCatalogService that reads the selected version's data/{base,space-age}/prototypes/autoplace-controls.lua and the effective enabled content set (base plus expansion flags and persisted enabled mods). It returns catalog version, content fingerprint, five fixed supported surfaces, and only parsed declared control IDs with category, richness capability, and can-be-disabled capability. Persist dynamic explicit overrides as a dictionary keyed by Factorio control ID in MapGenerationSettings; validate submitted IDs and override fields against the current catalog, discard legacy unknown IDs on serialization, and emit catalog-approved overrides only under map-gen autoplace_controls. Keep existing runtime enemy/evolution/expansion serialization exclusively in map-settings. Add GET /api/map-controls/catalog and validate catalog-backed settings in PUT /api/settings; CreateSaveAsync must resolve the catalog from ActiveVersion and the same effective enabled mod set before writing --map-gen-settings. Replace the Web fixed resource editor with catalog-driven controls grouped by Nauvis, Vulcanus, Gleba, Fulgora, and Aquilo, preserving profile drafts by control ID. Add API tests for version/content discovery, five-surface filtering, disabled/unknown omission, override persistence, and map-gen/map-settings partitioning.

evidence.outcome: Defines installed base control IDs and capabilities, including iron-ore, copper-ore, water, trees, nauvis_cliff, and enemy-base.

Defines installed Space Age control IDs and capabilities, including vulcanus_coal, tungsten_ore, calcite, sulfuric_acid_geyser, gleba_stone, scrap, aquilo_crude_oil, fluorine_vent, lithium_brine, cliffs, and non-disableable terrain/enemy controls.
Shows the version-bundled Space Age content and a runtime enabled custom mod; catalog eligibility must use the effective runtime set rather than assume all discovered files are enabled.
Save creation already writes separate --map-gen-settings and --map-settings files and synthesizes the effective mod-list, providing the routing point for catalog resolution.
Settings currently use a fixed MapGenerationSettings shape and PUT /api/settings validates without version/content-aware controls.
The UI has fixed Nauvis-style MapGeneration fields and expansion profiles, so it cannot render or retain a catalog-defined per-surface control set.
Existing tests cover fixed control serialization and map-gen/map-settings separation; catalog contract coverage belongs here.

next_slice.summary: Developer: implement the catalog service, catalog-backed override model and validation, catalog endpoint, save-create serialization routing, catalog-driven settings UI, and regression tests. Preserve legacy fixed settings only as migration input; never serialize an unknown control ID.

blockers: The supplied Lua control declarations establish IDs and capabilities but do not themselves expose localized display strings or an explicit surface-membership field; use a reviewed five-surface routing manifest based only on declared Factorio IDs, and do not infer controls from names or emit unlisted JSON keys.
